They help you recover from more intense workouts and prepare you for the challenges ahead. As you run, focus on your breathing and let your mind relax. This is your time to reflect on your goals and visualize your success. Remember, every easy run is a step towards your ultimate goal. Embrace the process, and let each run rejuvenate you.
